main_body: Sci-fi tower: an upper sloped roof over a window band, a central shaft with a screen and hatch, and a lower sloped roof over a door facade with a gate.
top_band: Upper roof: rows 8-16 are a blue-grey sloped surface (L118 to 148 to 178, lightest at the front edge, rows 15-16), closed by a row-17 edge line. The lower roof, rows 52-62, repeats this.
evidence: In the column scan, the upper roof (rows 8-16, L118-178) steps to a dark row 18 and then the front face with windows (rows 18-30). The roof is a clear, tall top slope, wider than the body below, with a bright front-edge band (rows 15-16) and a dark eave under it (rows 18-21). The lower roof (rows 52-62) is panelled and slopes the same way, above a door facade (rows 64-79) with a dark inset door. The central shaft is a vertical face that joins the two roofs, and it does not break the contract. No receding side faces are drawn.
